name: Pizzeria Toscana
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Toscana in Tirol**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! At **Pizzeria Toscana**, we bring the taste of **Toscana** to you with freshly baked pizzas, handmade pasta, and delicious Italian specialties. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a creamy **Carbonara**, our menu has something for everyone.

Indulge in our famous **Tiramisu** or enjoy a glass of fine Italian wine while soaking in the cozy atmosphere. Located in the charming town of **Innsbruck**, we’re the perfect spot for a relaxed dinner after exploring the stunning **Alpenlandschaft** or a quick bite before heading to the **Nordkette**.

Come taste the sun of **Toscana** in **Tirol**—your Italian escape awaits!
